Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000671": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)

- memory_id "1000585": As of 2025-07-28, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of its requests were identical.  (about: feature-flags service)

- memory_id "1000516" [decision]: As of 2025-06-27, Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000512": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000486": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000406": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000314": Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000291": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000286": The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run.  (about: feature-flags service, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000228": The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000221": On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000205": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000193": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000156" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000042": The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, feature-flags service)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, catalog service, Team Cinder, billing service, ledger, feature-flags service, clients, notifier, Team Boreal, event bus, Team Dune, webhooks service, Ember team, auth gateway, scheduler, push provider, INC-2025-004
